facts.text: Evan experienced a health scare last week that required a hospital visit due to a suspicious finding during a check-up.

evidence.quote: Last week, I had a health scare and had to go to the hospital. They found something suspicious during a check-up, which freaked me out.

facts.text: Evan was reassured that the health scare was a misunderstanding and that his doctors confirmed everything is fine.

evidence.quote: Doctors said everything is fine, but it taught me the value of life.
